assumptions.assumption: a TXDATA write while busy is ignored rather than queued.
assumptions.reason: the request has no queue; ignoring is the simplest safe rule.

assumptions.assumption: the first SCLK edge comes one half period after CS_N falls, and CS_N rises one half period after the last edge.
assumptions.reason: gives the slave one half period of setup and hold around chip select.

behaviour: A write to TXDATA while BUSY = 0 starts a frame of N bits (N = 16 if CTRL.W16 = 1, else 8) with TXDATA's bits [N-1:0]. A write to TXDATA while BUSY = 1 is ignored (TXDATA keeps its value).
CTRL (except CS_HOLD) and DIV are taken when a frame starts; changing them during a frame does not affect it.
Bit order - MSB first (bit N-1 first) unless CTRL.LSB = 1 (bit 0 first). Received bits fill RXDATA in the same order (the first bit received lands in bit N-1, or in bit 0 with LSB = 1).

Let t = 0 be the clock on which CS_N goes low for the frame (or, with CS_N already held low, the clock on which the frame starts). SCLK has 2N edges, at t = k*DIV for k = 1..2N (exactly DIV clocks apart); before the first edge and after the last SCLK is at its idle level CPOL.

Edges k odd are leading edges, k even trailing edges. CPHA = 0 - MOSI carries the first bit from t = 0, the slave samples on leading edges, MOSI changes to the next bit on each trailing edge (except the last). CPHA = 1 - MOSI changes to bit i on leading edge 2i+1 and the slave samples on trailing edges.
The master samples MISO at the same edges the slave samples MOSI (MISO is synchronised by two flops, so DIV of 5 or more is needed for a slave that changes MISO on the opposite edge).
The frame ends at t = (2N+1)*DIV - BUSY falls, DONE is set, RXDATA is updated, and CS_N goes high on that clock unless CTRL.CS_HOLD = 1.
MOSI is 0 while no frame is in progress.
CS_N goes low when a frame starts (if it is not already low).

While no frame is in progress, CS_N is high whenever CTRL.CS_HOLD = 0 - clearing CS_HOLD after held frames releases CS_N within 2 clocks of the CTRL write. Setting CS_HOLD alone never drives CS_N low.
With CTRL.LOOP = 1 the master's MISO input is its own MOSI output (JB3 ignored); the pins still carry the frame.
DIV is 16 bits; a write whose bits [15:0] are below 2 is ignored entirely. Reset 50 (SCLK 1 MHz).
DONE is set at every frame end and stays set until a write to STATUS with bit 1 = 1. Reads never clear it.

"""Acceptance tests of t2_spi_master_modes against model.py (hidden from the agent)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import random

import cocotb
from benchmark.lib.bench import Board, peek
from model import (BUSY, CPHA, CPOL, CS_ACTIVE, CS_HOLD, CTRL, DESIGN_ID, DIV, DONE, LOOP, LSB, RXDATA, STATUS,
                   TXDATA, W16, Model, nbits, tx_bits)
from spi_slave import SpiSlave


class Env:
    def __init__(self, dut) -> None:
        self.b = Board(dut, {"JB3": 0})
        self.dut, self.m = dut, Model()

    async def start(self) -> None:
        await self.b.start()
        self.s = SpiSlave(self.dut)

    async def wr(self, off: int, v: int) -> None:
        await self.b.write(off, v)
        self.m.write(off, v)

    async def regs(self) -> None:
        for off, name in ((CTRL, "CTRL"), (DIV, "DIV"), (TXDATA, "TXDATA"), (RXDATA, "RXDATA"), (STATUS, "STATUS")):
            await self.b.expect(off, self.m.read(off), name)

    async def setup(self, ctrl: int, div: int) -> None:
        await self.wr(CTRL, ctrl)
        await self.wr(DIV, div)

    async def frames(self, values: list[int], miso: list[int] | None = None) -> None:
        """Send frames back to back (CS held between them if CS_HOLD) and check every pin against the model."""
        c, d = self.m.ctrl, self.m.div
        miso = miso or [0] * len(values)
        q: list[int] = []
        for v in miso:
            q += tx_bits(v, c)
        cs_was_low = self.m.cs_low
        self.s.mode(c & CPOL, (c & CPHA) >> 1, q)
        want_mosi: list[int] = []
        for v, r in zip(values, miso):
            await self.b.write(TXDATA, v)
            self.m.write(TXDATA, v)
            await self.b.cycles((2 * nbits(c) + 1) * d + 8)
            want_mosi.append(self.m.finish(tx_bits(r, c)))
        self.check_pins(want_mosi, cs_was_low)
        await self.regs()

    def check_pins(self, want_mosi: list[list[int]], cs_was_low: bool) -> None:
        c, d, s = self.m.ctrl, self.m.div, self.s
        n = nbits(c)
        cpol, cpha = c & CPOL, (c & CPHA) >> 1
        assert not s.idle_bad, s.idle_bad
        edges = s.edges
        assert len(edges) == 2 * n * len(want_mosi), f"{len(edges)} SCLK edges, model {2 * n * len(want_mosi)}"
        falls = [t for t, v in s.cs_events if v == 0]
        rises = [t for t, v in s.cs_events if v == 1]
        nf = len(want_mosi)
        if c & CS_HOLD:
            assert len(falls) == (0 if cs_was_low else 1), f"CS_N fell {len(falls)} times with CS_HOLD"
            assert not rises, "CS_N rose although CS_HOLD is set"
            if falls:
                assert d <= edges[0][0] - falls[0] <= 2 * d, f"first edge {edges[0][0] - falls[0]} clocks after CS_N fell"
        else:
            n_fall = nf - (1 if cs_was_low else 0)
            assert len(falls) == n_fall and len(rises) == nf, f"CS_N fell {len(falls)} / rose {len(rises)} times"
            for f in range(nf):
                first, last = edges[2 * n * f][0], edges[2 * n * f + 2 * n - 1][0]
                if f < len(falls) or not cs_was_low:
                    t_fall = falls[f - (1 if cs_was_low else 0)] if (f > 0 or not cs_was_low) else None
                    if t_fall is not None:
                        assert d <= first - t_fall <= 2 * d, f"frame {f}: first edge {first - t_fall} after CS_N fell"
                assert d <= rises[f] - last <= 2 * d, f"frame {f}: CS_N rose {rises[f] - last} clocks after the last edge"
        for f, want in enumerate(want_mosi):
            fe = edges[2 * n * f:2 * n * (f + 1)]
            gaps = [b[0] - a[0] for a, b in zip(fe, fe[1:])]
            assert set(gaps) == {d}, f"frame {f}: SCLK edge spacing {sorted(set(gaps))}, DIV {d}"
            levels = [lv for _, lv, _ in fe]
            assert levels == [1 - cpol, cpol] * n, f"frame {f}: SCLK levels {levels} (CPOL {cpol})"
            sampled = [mo for k, (_, _, mo) in enumerate(fe) if (k % 2) == cpha]
            assert sampled == want, f"frame {f}: MOSI at the sample edges {sampled}, model {want}"
        for a, b in zip(range(len(want_mosi) - 1), range(1, len(want_mosi))):
            gap = edges[2 * n * b][0] - edges[2 * n * a + 2 * n - 1][0]
            assert gap >= 2 * d, f"frames {a},{b}: only {gap} clocks between them"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1219930, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_identity_and_reset(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    assert await e.b.shell_id() == DESIGN_ID
    await e.regs()
    for off in (0x05, 0x40, 0x7F):
        await e.b.expect(off, 0, "unmapped")
    assert [await peek(e.b.clk, getattr(dut, p)) for p in ("JB1", "JB2", "JB4")] == [1, 0, 0], "idle pins"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1562740, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_divisor_rule(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    for v in (1, 0, 2, 0x0001_0001, 0x0003_0007, 0xFFFF):
        await e.wr(DIV, v)
        await e.b.expect(DIV, e.m.read(DIV), f"DIV after {v:#x}")
    await e.wr(CTRL, 0xFFFF_FFC0 | LOOP)
    await e.b.expect(CTRL, e.m.read(CTRL), "CTRL")
    await e.setup(LOOP, 2)                     # the fastest SCLK, in loopback
    await e.frames([0xA6, 0x01])


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1494720, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_mode0_msb_first(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    await e.setup(0, 6)
    await e.frames([0x9C], [0x3A])
    await e.frames([0x00], [0xFF])
    await e.frames([0xFF], [0x81])


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1371460, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_mode3_idle_high(dut):
    """Trap: a mode-0-only master (the textbook's accelerometer SPI) fails here: in mode 3 SCLK idles high, MOSI
    changes on falling edges and both sides sample on rising edges."""
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    await e.setup(CPOL | CPHA, 5)
    assert await peek(e.b.clk, dut.JB4) == 1, "SCLK does not idle high in mode 3"
    await e.frames([0xC5], [0x5C])
    await e.wr(CTRL, CPOL | CPHA | W16)
    await e.frames([0x8001], [0x7FFE])


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1793040, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_modes_1_and_2(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    for c in (CPHA, CPOL, CPHA | LSB, CPOL | W16):
        await e.setup(c, 7)
        await e.frames([0x5A3C & (0xFFFF if c & W16 else 0xFF)], [0xC3A5 & (0xFFFF if c & W16 else 0xFF)])


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1995720, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_lsb_first_16bit(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    for mode in range(4):
        await e.setup(mode | LSB | W16, 5 + mode)
        await e.frames([0x1234 + mode], [0xF00D ^ mode])
    await e.setup(LSB, 6)
    await e.frames([0x0180], [0x00C1])         # an 8-bit frame uses bits [7:0] only


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1692380, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_cs_hold_across_frames(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    await e.setup(CS_HOLD, 5)
    assert await peek(e.b.clk, dut.JB1) == 1, "CS_HOLD alone pulled CS_N low"
    await e.regs()
    await e.frames([0x0B, 0x2D, 0x00], [0x00, 0x00, 0x02])
    assert await peek(e.b.clk, dut.JB1) == 0, "CS_N released while CS_HOLD is set"
    await e.wr(CTRL, CS_HOLD | W16)            # still held; a further 16-bit frame
    await e.frames([0xBEEF], [0x1357])
    await e.wr(CTRL, W16)                      # clear CS_HOLD: CS_N goes high
    await e.b.cycles(4)
    assert await peek(e.b.clk, dut.JB1) == 1, "clearing CS_HOLD did not release CS_N"
    await e.regs()


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1751280, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_busy_and_done(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    await e.setup(LOOP, 200)                    # a frame lasts 17 * 200 clocks: longer than a shell access
    await e.b.write(TXDATA, 0x6B)
    e.m.write(TXDATA, 0x6B)
    await e.b.expect(STATUS, BUSY | CS_ACTIVE, "STATUS during a frame")
    await e.b.write(TXDATA, 0x11)               # ignored while busy
    await e.b.expect(TXDATA, 0x6B, "TXDATA after a write while busy")
    await e.b.cycles(17 * 200)
    e.m.finish()
    await e.regs()
    await e.regs()                              # reading STATUS does not clear DONE
    await e.wr(STATUS, 0xFFFF_FFFD)             # bit 1 clear: DONE stays
    await e.regs()
    await e.wr(STATUS, DONE)
    await e.regs()


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=1787280, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_loopback(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    for c in (LOOP, LOOP | CPHA | W16, LOOP | CPOL | LSB, LOOP | CPOL | CPHA | W16 | LSB):
        await e.setup(c, 3)
        dut.JB3.value = 1                        # the pin is ignored
        await e.frames([0xD25A & (0xFFFF if c & W16 else 0xFF)])
    dut.JB3.value = 0


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=2853900, timeout_unit="ns")
async def test_random_frames(dut):
    e = Env(dut)
    await e.start()
    rng = random.Random(int(cocotb.RANDOM_SEED))
    for _ in range(8):
        c = rng.randrange(16) | (CS_HOLD if rng.random() < 0.3 else 0)
        await e.setup(c, rng.randrange(5, 10))
        mask = 0xFFFF if c & W16 else 0xFF
        k = rng.randrange(1, 3)
        dut._log.info(f"random frame ctrl={c:#x} div={e.m.div} k={k}")
        await e.frames([rng.randrange(1 << 16) & mask for _ in range(k)], [rng.randrange(1 << 16) & mask for _ in range(k)])
    await e.wr(CTRL, 0)
    await e.b.cycles(4)
    await e.regs()

requirements.text: All four CPOL/CPHA modes put out and sample data on the edges listed, with SCLK idle at CPOL
8- and 16-bit frames, MSB or LSB first, with RXDATA filled in the same order
SCLK edges are exactly DIV clocks apart; DIV writes below 2 are ignored
CS_HOLD keeps CS_N low across frames and clearing it releases CS_N
Loopback returns each frame's data in RXDATA
The design closes timing at 100 MHz with no unconstrained path

spec_md:
# General-purpose SPI master on Pmod JB

I want an SPI master on Pmod JB of the Nexys A7-100T that I can point at whatever SPI part I plug in later, so it
must not assume one device.

- Pins: JB1 is chip select (active low), JB2 MOSI, JB3 MISO, JB4 SCLK.
- All four SPI modes (clock polarity and phase both selectable), MSB-first by default with an LSB-first option,
  and 8-bit or 16-bit frames.
- SCLK speed from a divisor register that gives the SCLK half period in 100 MHz clocks; 2 is the smallest that
  makes sense, so anything smaller is not accepted. After reset I'd like 1 MHz.
- Normally chip select goes low for one frame and back high after it, but I need a "hold" setting that keeps it low
  across several frames (for parts that want a command and then data in one select), and releases it when I clear
  the setting.
- Writing the transmit register starts a frame. The received frame is readable afterwards. Status: busy, and a
  done flag I clear by writing 1 to it.
- With nothing plugged in I still want to test it on the board, so add an internal loopback (MISO fed from our
  own MOSI).
- Everything through the test shell; design ID "SPIM".

Test hooks: top module `t2_spi_master_modes_top`, ports named as in the board's master XDC (`JB1`, `JB2`, `JB3`,
`JB4`, the USB-UART pins, `CLK100MHZ`, `CPU_RESETN`), the test shell's `CLKS_PER_BIT`, `TIMEOUT_CYCLES` and
`BUILD_STAMP` parameters as top-level parameters. The SCLK rate comes only from the divisor register.
title: General-purpose SPI master on Pmod JB, all four modes

Step 2: Edge 2 (trailing): SCLK goes low. The data lines move on to the next bit.

trace.stimulus: Divisor 5, so SCLK edges are 5 clocks apart. Frame 1 sends 0xa5 in mode 0 (idle low, sample on the leading edge) to a slave that answers 0x3c. Frame 2 sends 0xa5 in mode 3 (idle high, sample on the trailing edge), least significant bit first, with MISO looped back from MOSI. The bit order and RXDATA come from the model; the SCLK edges are drawn from the spec's mode rules, which the model does not clock. MOSI and MISO are shown as 0 when no bit is being driven.

what: A general-purpose SPI master for whatever chip is plugged in later. It supports all four clock polarity and phase modes, most-significant or least-significant bit first, and eight-bit or sixteen-bit frames, with a settable clock speed. Writing the transmit register starts a frame, and chip select can be held low across several frames. An internal loopback feeds the data output back to the input, so it can be tested with nothing connected.
where: SPI is the usual fast link to flash memory, ADCs and DACs, displays, sensors and radio chips, and the four modes exist because different chips expect the clock and data to line up differently. A flexible master like this is a standard part of any microcontroller or FPGA toolkit.
